name: Magician Nelly
source:
Circus magician - "Weirglod". Nelly is the mtsyr who can deform her body.
He mainly allows changing the size of his hands and neck. He is friends with Professor Evia Ioannidis and with the writer Latinia Mariani.
Nelly has a thin body due to illness. According to the "Longevity" system, Nelly is a mtsyr of average rank
